title: Baseline: 186-claude pretrained weights + frozen harness expert iteration, replayed
description: Loads 186-claude's pretrain.pt per seed through a shim pretrain.py and runs the frozen harness unchanged (4 rounds x 1,500 targets x 32 samples, 600 FT steps/round, eval k=64). Sets the combined-pipeline bar on the same day and checks the checkpoint handoff; only RL/eval sampling noise differs from 186.
hypothesis: A replay of 186's RL stage from its own pretrained weights reproduces 186 up to RL sampling noise.

pretrain.arch: ALiBiGPT 6x384 Peri-LN, 8 heads (4 ALiBi + 4 NoPE), d_ff 1280

config.data: fork 51604b3: train.jsonl cap-6 (retention), 1,500 rl_targets sampled with the harness seed, dev half of transfer (1,108) for eval
config.eval: frozen harness stage_eval: EVAL_K 64, T 0.8, max_new 512; metric = dev solved at L_true >= 7

rl.recipe: frozen harness stage_rl (ladder T1 expert iteration)
